payload.instruction: transform the black DVD into a white DVD
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

outcome.description: Transform the original black DVD into a white DVD, preserving the same disc at its source location and its recognizable DVD form, including the center hole.
outcome.target: The original DVD near the center of the source image, between the shoe at lower left and the dark object at right, has a visibly white disc surface and remains recognizable as the same DVD with a center hole. A newly added white disc, or a white object elsewhere, does not fulfill the request.
outcome.reference: The small dark rectangular DVD case/disc object near the center of the source image, just right of the shoe and left of the dark object. Compare its position and appearance in the source and edited images to identify the original object.

check.question: Has the original black DVD been transformed into a white DVD?
check.complete_when: The same DVD at the source location has a visibly white disc surface and remains recognizable as a DVD, including its center hole.
check.partial_when: The original DVD at the source location is identifiable and some of its surface has been changed toward white, but it is not fully white or its recognizable disc form/center hole is not clearly preserved.
check.absent_when: The original DVD remains black or unchanged, is missing, or has no visible progress toward white. Also absent if only a separate white disc/object is added while the original DVD remains untransformed; a white disc without a visible center hole at the original location does not establish complete fulfillment.
check.unknown_when: The original DVD cannot be confidently identified at its source location, or its color and transformation cannot be assessed from the available images.

response.content: {"status":"partial","evidence":"The original DVD at the center source location has been changed from a dark rectangular object into a white disc, showing progress toward the request. However, it has no clearly visible center hole, so the recognizable DVD form is not fully preserved."}

parsed.evidence: The original DVD at the center source location has been changed from a dark rectangular object into a white disc, showing progress toward the request. However, it has no clearly visible center hole, so the recognizable DVD form is not fully preserved.
